scientific_purpose: First guarded real-data fit of the ES-WAM native fast/slow exchange-structured world model on existing historically exposed original BodenAI robot FIT source; exactly ME076 eligible real cases and per-seed training schedule; jointly score factual next-physical-state MAE/NLL and next recorded qpos behavioral imitation. Exposed DEV only; no causal action choice, no architecture superiority, no independent benefit claim.

real_world_source.name: BodenAI/RW-RL-HIL-Dataset, frozen revision 9290f5a96dc91ea58256e81d9ce2dd9621890b51, original ME064 registered five authentic tasks previously exposed FIT 160 episodes; CC-BY-4.0 with publisher attribution

training_budget.selection: frozen SHA256 task/episode lexicographic 24 FIT / 8 previously exposed original FIT-DEV per task
training_budget.train_window_sampling: seeded equal-task task round robin with half outcome-change >0.025 physical mean units and half uniform, within FIT only
training_budget.checkpoint: original final optimizer update only; five seeds, complete checkpoint+optimizer/RNG in Git before scoring replay
training_budget.auxiliary_target: logged future issued action[t] at scoring origin t; training only; not input to the forecast (last input is action[t-1])
training_budget.loss: real next-state normalized Laplace NLL plus 0.05 times recorded next-command SmoothL1 imitation

primary_development_measure: real 14D physical MAE and Laplace NLL, same original 960 episode-disjoint queries/seed, paired persistence, FIT servo, original frozen ME076 per-case checkpoint outputs
measurable_promotion_rule: DEV_CAPABILITY_OBSERVED only if actual real source outcomes and source-matched practical baselines improve with all five seed signs; no full compute parity, causal action or independent source claim
source_train_fit_qualification: metadata and normalized state/action computed only from designated FIT episode members; source fingerprint includes entire original five-task FIT 160 archive but eval rows never used for normalization
guard: live full-parameter preflight 100343 before every guarded optimizer step, original Git checkpoint and scorer receipt; compare frozen ME076 on identical 960 factual cases
